user.title: SmartGrow setup
user.description: Pick the source entities for this tent. Required: fan + tent temperature/humidity. Everything else is optional and degrades gracefully.

data_description.name: Shown on the device and all SmartGrow entities. Use a name per tent if you have several.
data_description.fan_entity: The fan SmartGrow controls. Percentage-controlled EC fans get full proportional control; simple on/off fans work in on/off mode.
data_description.tent_temp_entity: Temperature inside the tent. Drives the temperature-safety term and VPD.
data_description.tent_rh_entity: Relative humidity inside the tent. Drives the moisture-export term.
data_description.dehum_entity: Switch or humidifier entity of your dehumidifier. If omitted, SmartGrow runs in fan-only mode and never touches the dehumidifier.
data_description.lung_temp_entity: Temperature of the room the tent pulls air from (the 'lung room'). Falls back to the tent value if omitted — the moisture-export term then does the work alone.
data_description.lung_rh_entity: Humidity of the lung room. Falls back to the tent value if omitted.
data_description.vpd_entity: Existing VPD sensor. If omitted, VPD is computed internally from tent temperature and humidity (Magnus formula).
data_description.lamp_entity: Your grow lamp. Used to determine day/night phase (which selects the VPD band and fan floors). If schedule times are set, SmartGrow also switches this lamp.
data_description.lights_on_time: Time SmartGrow switches the lamp on (day start). Leave empty if another automation already handles the lamp.
data_description.lights_off_time: Time SmartGrow switches the lamp off (night start). Overnight windows (20:00 → 04:00) are supported.
data_description.wavemaker_entity: Switch that toggles the wavemaker pump. If omitted, wavemaker automation stays off.
data_description.wavemaker_mode: with_lights: wavemaker runs whenever the lamp is on. interval: runs for the run duration every interval minutes.
data_description.wavemaker_run_s: How long the wavemaker runs each time (interval mode only).
data_description.wavemaker_every_min: How often the wavemaker switches on (interval mode only).
data_description.dry_run: While ON, SmartGrow only WATCHES: it calculates what the fan and dehumidifier should do and logs it, but does not touch your devices. This lets you verify its decisions safely first. Turn it OFF (from the device screen) only when you trust the decisions — typically after 24-48 hours of correct-looking logs.
data_description.camera_entity: A camera watching the tent. SmartGrow links it to the card so you can see the plants at a glance; agents can later use it to optically check plant status.

extras.title: Legacy automations (optional)
extras.description: If old vent/dehumidifier automations are still running, select them so SmartGrow can warn you while they actuate in parallel.

data_description.legacy_vent_automation: SmartGrow raises a warning on the card while this automation triggers, so you know both systems are active.
data_description.legacy_dehum_automation: Same as above, for your dehumidifier automation.
data_description.stage: What stage are your plants in right now? Sets the VPD band: Seedling 0.8-1.1 kPa, Vegetative 1.1-1.4, Flowering 1.5-1.8 (day values). You can change this anytime via the SmartGrow stage entity.

error.entities_already_configured: One or more of these entities is already used by another SmartGrow entry. Each tent needs its own sensors/fan.

abort.already_configured: This tent sensor pair is already configured.

init.title: SmartGrow tuning
init.description: Control-law tuning. Defaults are the proven production values — change only with cause. All gains multiply how strongly each term pushes the fan target.

data_description.fan_floor_day: Minimum fan speed during the day, regardless of VPD. Keeps air moving.
data_description.fan_floor_night: Minimum fan speed at night. Lower than day to avoid over-drying.
data_description.delta_gain: Fan % added per g/m³ absolute-humidity difference between tent and lung room. The moisture-export term.
data_description.vpd_gain: Fan % added per kPa below the VPD band. How aggressively the fan responds to a dry tent.
data_description.need_gain: Fan % added on top of a 50% base per kPa below the band. Drives convergence while below target.
data_description.temp_gain: Fan % added per °C above (max − 2 °C). Heat-protection term.
data_description.cold_clamp: Multiplier on the moisture terms when tent temperature is below the stage minimum (0.5 = half strength). Prevents over-ventilation in the cold.
data_description.dehum_sat_trigger: If the fan runs at or above this % and tent humidity is still high, the dehumidifier engages — the fan is saturated, so the dehumidifier takes over.
data_description.dehum_dry_floor: Lung-room RH below which the dehumidifier stops, to protect intake air from over-drying.
data_description.band_low_day: Overrides the stage's day VPD band lower bound (0 = use stage table).
data_description.band_low_night: Overrides the stage's night VPD band lower bound (0 = use stage table).
data_description.adaptation_enabled: Self-tunes gains over time (watchdog-guarded: freezes at >40% drift).
data_description.adaptation_aggressiveness: How fast adaptation moves. 1.0 = normal, higher = faster (and riskier).
data_description.dry_run: Watch-only mode: SmartGrow computes decisions and logs them without ever commanding the fan or dehumidifier. Leave on until you trust its behaviour.
